note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-4 Thyssen Henschel manufacturer brochure for the Marder 1A3 infantry combat vehicle. The brochure is a maker product document, so every value is grade claimed. It publishes identity, the combat weight of 28.6 metric tons, the MTU MB 833 Ea 500 six-cylinder turbocharged diesel rated at 440 kW (590 hp), the Renk HSWL 194 hydro-mechanical shift transmission with four forward and two reverse gears, the maximum road speed of 75 km/h, the crew of ten, the armament and the Diehl tracks. It publishes no overall length, width or height, no ground clearance, no track shoe width and no track pitch, so the entry resolves only the held weight, the derived net power and the transmission type and the tracked entry is not runtime-ready. The combat weight is recorded as the operating weight with the state naming the published figure; the brochure publishes no separate kerb or gross weight.
